name: GUNSHI
source:
If you win you get a reward, if you lose you are humiliated.

My name is Gaius Lavienus.

As per Princess Elena's precise suggestions, I will lead the third company to victory.
If I win, princess Elena will reward me.
If I lose, princess Elena will humiliate me.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031940.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
如果你赢了，你会得到奖励，如果你输了，你会受到羞辱。

我的名字是盖乌斯·拉维努斯。

按照艾琳娜公主的精确建议，我将带领第三连取得胜利。
如果我赢了，艾琳娜公主就会奖励我。
如果我输了，艾琳娜公主就会羞辱我。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031940.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
